department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Safe, low-cost hostels for working women. Rent is Rs 300 a month in Chennai and Rs 200 a month in other places. You share the cost of food, electricity and other charges. The government runs 21 such hostels.

other: You must be a working woman.
Your pay must be up to Rs 25,000 a month in Chennai, or up to Rs 15,000 a month in other places.

how_to_apply: Go to a government working women hostel near your work and ask for a place. The list of hostel addresses is on the Social Welfare Department website. For Thozhi hostels, see tnwwhcl.in.
where_to_apply: Government Working Women Hostel in your town

evidence.quote: the Government runs 21 Working Women Hostels
They have to pay a monthly rent of Rs.300 in Chennai and Rs.200 in other places.
Sharing system is followed for food expenses, electricity and other charges.
Women who earn upto Rs.25,000 per month at Chennai
